quizQuestionPool.title: Smart Quizzes
quizQuestionPool.intro: Hyperion generates multiple-choice questions for every lecture unit linked to a competency of this course, grounded in that unit's slides, transcript or text, and judges each one before you see it. Approve the questions you want to use in quizzes and exclude the ones you do not. The approved questions will later also drive personalised learning: students practise with questions tailored to their strengths and weaknesses.

settings.title: Settings

settings.correctOptionsOrder: The smallest number must not exceed the largest.
settings.difficultyMixHelp: Share of each lecture unit's questions generated at each difficulty. The three shares must add up to 100 %.
